release.reason: Releasing on Ethereum needs the outbound proof (G2), which proves LEZ burns to the vault. It is not built yet, so no exit can be released today.
release.vault_note: This deployment's vault is a demo whose outbound image is a placeholder: it can never release, even after G2 exists. A new vault version is needed.
release.what_happens_next: Once G2 runs, the vault records exit roots; after the release delay, anyone (you or a relayer, paid the fee you chose) proves your exit and the vault pays the recipient you fixed when burning.
